title: Move Customers lists the term's customers A to Z, all ticked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers, customer A, customer B and customer C (a new term holds only this case's customers), whose names are in that A to Z order, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from term A" opens.
  • It shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box.
  • "Select All" and "Select None" with "3 selected" on the right.
  • A list of customer A, customer B and customer C in that order, each with a ticked checkbox.
  • A "Move To" dropdown reading Net 30, with the hint "Prefilled with your default for new customers." below it.
  • The buttons "Cancel" and "Move 3 Customers".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R1: “"Move Customers" in a term's row menu (Story 2: Row menu actions) opens a window titled "Move Customers from {term}".”
  • S4-R2: “The window shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "{n} selected" on the right; a scrolling list of every customer on the term, A to Z, each with a checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move {n} Customers" ("Move 1 Customer" when one is selected).”
  • S4-R4: “Every listed customer starts ticked.”
  • S4-R7: “"Move To" offers every active term except the one being moved from, in the S1-R5 order. It is prefilled with the shop's default; while the default is selected, the hint "Prefilled with your default for new customers." shows below it. When the term being moved from is the default, "Move To" starts empty.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move To hint | "Prefilled with your default for new customers." | Hint under Move To while the default is selected”
  • S2-R1 table, Move Customers row: “"Move Customers" (person) | Every term, active or inactive | The user lacks 'Customers → Create & Edit' or 'View and Manage AP/AR Data': "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." Otherwise no customer holds the term: "No customers are on this term"”
